verdict.rationale: The pricing page publishes wallet MAU overages and generic checkout/onramp/offramp fee tiers, but explicitly does not publish any fee specific to agent cards or agent checkouts — the actual agent-originated transaction channels — per crossmint-supp-9's own note that 'No agent-card- or agent-checkout-specific price is published on the pricing page.' A merchant wanting to price the agentic channel itself would still need to contact sales.
